trigger_condition: User clicks the visible label text with pointer or touch
potential_consequence: Label click does nothing; expected click-to-focus UX broken for all users

trigger_condition: ariaLabelledBy provided but Quill onLoad never fires (init error)
guard_snippet: if (!quill) console.warn('Editor: ariaLabelledBy set but Quill not ready')
potential_consequence: aria-labelledby silently absent on editor root; screen reader users receive no label

trigger_condition: ariaLabelledBy transitions truthy→falsy while Quill reinitializes simultaneously
potential_consequence: Stale aria-labelledby persists on new Quill root after reinitialization with falsy prop

trigger_condition: placeholder and label carry identical text; empty editor focused by screen reader
guard_snippet: placeholder="Type your prompt here" or omit placeholder when visible label exists
potential_consequence: Some AT announces field name twice in sequence; confusing audible experience
